query_text: my service canada account log in

messages.content: my service canada account log in

message.content:
To **log in to My Service Canada Account (MSCA)**, go to the MSCA sign-in page and use the same option you originally registered with: **GCKey**, **Interac® Sign-In Partner**, or a **provincial sign-in**.[2][4] If you used one option when creating the account, you must keep using that same option unless you register for another one.[2]

A few useful points:
- MSCA is the secure portal for services such as **EI**, **CPP**, **OAS**, **direct deposit**, **ROE**, and some other Government of Canada benefits and services.[2][5]
- If you registered with **GCKey**, you sign in with your GCKey username and password.[2]
- If you registered with **Interac® Sign-In Partner**, you sign in using your online banking sign-in information.[2]
- If you live in a participating province, you may be able to sign in or register with your **provincial sign-in**.[4]

If you are trying to **register** instead of sign in, you may need your **access code** first.[1][3] If you need help with sign-in issues or account access, Service Canada directs users to **1 800 O-Canada**.[2]

If you want, I can also give you the **exact step-by-step login path** for the option you use: **GCKey**, **bank sign-in**, or **provincial sign-in**.
